name: Robe
summary: This long velvet gown is in nearly perfect condition. It is a man's robe, of a type that, in the first decades of the 20th century - and, in fact, right up to the end of the 1940s - was frequently worn with Western-style trousers, leather lace-up shoes and a velour trilby hat.
